tension: Indian consumers are seeking holistic approaches to wellness, with a focus on gut health and digestion, driven by cultural associations and increasing awareness of the importance of overall health. This has led to a growing interest in science-led synbiotic supplements and traditional practices that promote well-being.
why_now: The recent investments in gut health-focused brands and gourmet retail startups, along with the ban on ashwagandha leaves, have created a sense of urgency and opportunity for brands like The Good Bug to establish themselves as leaders in the wellness space. The current market landscape and consumer trends make it an ideal time for The Good Bug to capitalize on the growing demand for effective and trustworthy wellness solutions.
